decks.notes: The focus of this deck is to quickly bring out Phyrexian Dreadnought while using a combination of counterspells, card draw, and disruption to protect it and prevent the opponent from countering or removing it. By stifling the opponent's abilities and controlling the game, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces efficiently and win the game through a quick and decisive attack with the Dreadnought. The deck's strategy revolves around setting up the combo and maintaining control of the game until it can execute its finishing move.

This premodern 1 vs 1 control deck focuses on using Oath of Druids to cheat out powerful creatures like Terravore while disrupting opponents with cards like Sphere of Resistance and Swords to Plowshares. The deck also includes land destruction spells like Thermokarst and Wasteland to keep opponents off balance, with additional utility from cards like Sylvan Library and Rishadan Port. The goal is to control the game through creature threats, disruption, and resource denial, ultimately overwhelming the opponent with efficient plays and powerful threats.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Mox Diamond and Weathered Wayfarer, while deploying aggressive threats such as Nimble Mongoose and Terravore. The deck also aims to disrupt the opponent's mana base with cards like Armageddon and Wasteland, while utilizing efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares to deal with any threats the opponent may have. The deck also has strong card draw capabilities with Sylvan Library to ensure a consistent stream of threats.

This deck focuses on aggressive, quick plays using Madness and Threshold mechanics to quickly fill the graveyard and take advantage of powerful creatures like Arrogant Wurm and Basking Rootwalla. Merfolk Looter and Squee, Goblin Nabob add card advantage and graveyard filling, while Wild Mongrel acts as a versatile and powerful threat. Circular Logic and Counterspell provide control elements, while the mana base supports a mixture of blue and green spells. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with early threats and efficient card interactions.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize enchantresses to draw cards every time an enchantment spell is cast. By generating a large number of enchantments, the player can draw a significant amount of cards to find combo pieces such as Replenish and Opalescence to overwhelm their opponent. The deck also includes cards like Swords to Plowshares and Seal of Cleansing to control the opponent's board, while utilizing Serra's Sanctum to produce a large amount of mana to power out the combo pieces quickly.

The deck revolves around quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures and then bringing them back into play cheaply and efficiently. Cards like Akroma, Angel of Wrath and Phantom Nishoba can be brought back into play with Reanimate and Exhume, while cards like Careful Study and Cabal Therapy help to fill up the graveyard. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big creatures early in the game and win quickly before the opponent can set up their own game plan.

The deck aims to quickly get the Phyrexian Dreadnought on the battlefield, utilizing cards like Stifle to eliminate the negative aspect of Dreadnought's ability. It also includes a mix of countermagic and card draw to protect the combo and find the necessary pieces. The deck is focused on setting up and executing the combo efficiently while disrupting opponent's strategies with counterspells and Stifle effects. The goal is to win the game swiftly before the opponent can establish their game plan.

The Mono Black Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand and board presence through discard spells like Duress and Cabal Therapy, as well as utilizing cards like Hypnotic Specter and The Rack to apply pressure. Removal spells such as Diabolic Edict and Smother help control the board, while utility lands like Mishra's Factory and Wasteland provide additional disruption. The deck's strategy revolves around resource denial and grinding out incremental advantages to outlast and outplay the opponent in the long game.

The deck focuses on utilizing Hermit Druid to fill the graveyard with creatures, then using various combos such as Karmic Guide + Reveillark or Phyrexian Devourer + Triskelion to win the game. Support cards like Cabal Therapy and Survival of the Fittest help find the combo pieces, while cards like Unearth and Shallow Grave provide graveyard recursion. The mana base includes a variety of lands to ensure consistency in casting the necessary spells. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent before they can establish a strong board presence.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through counterspells and removal while growing powerful creatures like Quirion Dryad and Psychatog. By using cards like Portent and Opt to draw into more resources, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and maintain control of the board. The inclusion of cards like Duress and Meddling Mage helps disrupt the opponent's game plan while cards like Accumulated Knowledge provide additional card advantage. The deck also includes some creature removal with Swords to Plowshares and additional versatility with Fire / Ice.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures with the Madness and Threshold mechanics to overwhelm the opponent. By efficiently using mana and discarding cards for added benefits, the deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. The deck also includes removal spells and disruption to handle threats from the opponent while staying aggressive. With a mix of efficient creatures and versatile spells, this deck aims to be proactive and resilient in the Pre-Modern format.

The focus of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's strategy through discard spells like Duress and Unmask, as well as by using removal spells like Smother and Chain of Smog. The deck also aims to apply pressure by playing threats like Hypnotic Specter and Phyrexian Negator. The deck also utilizes cards like The Rack and Cursed Scroll to deal damage to the opponent over time. With a solid mana base including Wastelands and Mishra's Factories, the deck seeks to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent in a grindy match-up.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells and removal spells while using Psychatog as a win condition. It aims to draw cards and disrupt the opponent's game plan with efficient spells like Accumulated Knowledge and Duress. The mana base is optimized to support the deck's strategy and ensure consistency in casting its spells. Overall, the deck seeks to outlast the opponent and eventually overwhelm them with the power of Psychatog.

The main focus of this deck is to deal damage quickly and efficiently to the opponent through small, aggressive creatures and direct damage spells. It utilizes cards like Grim Lavamancer, Jackal Pup, and Mogg Fanatic to apply pressure early on, while also utilizing spells like Lightning Bolt, Incinerate, and Fireblast to finish off the opponent. The deck aims to win before the opponent can stabilize, using cards like Cursed Scroll and Sulfuric Vortex to maintain pressure and prevent life gain. Price of Progress and Earthquake are included for additional reach and removal.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive low-cost creatures and direct damage spells. By efficiently utilizing resources like spells and lands to deal damage directly to the opponent, it aims to rapidly reduce their life total to zero before they can stabilize or mount a counterattack. The synergy between the creatures and burn spells allows for a fast and consistent offensive strategy, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with destruction effects like Wasteland.

This deck focuses on utilizing cards that provide card advantage and disruption, allowing the player to control the pace of the game. By using creatures like Ravenous Baloth and Krosan Tusker to generate value and cards like Cabal Therapy and Duress to disrupt the opponent's hand, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast its opponent. Pernicious Deed and Haunting Echoes provide board control and graveyard hate, while cards like Genesis and Volrath's Stronghold offer recursion and resilience. The Rock archetype emphasizes resource management and attrition to grind out victories.
